title: Synthesizing Human Trajectory Anomalies: An LLM-Driven Framework with Map-Constrained Routing and Sensor Noise Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2606.10314v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Although the study of human trajectory anomalies is vital for spatial data mining, empirical research remains constrained by the lack of ground-truth datasets. Despite the availability of several real-world and simulated human trajectory datasets, most only include normal mobility patterns and lack annotated anomalies. This limitation primarily arises because anomalous events are rare in the real world and difficult to collect. Furthermore, collecting large-scale mobility data is hindered by strict privacy regulations and acquisition costs. translated_title: 人类轨迹异常合成：一种结合地图约束路由与传感器噪声模拟的大语言模型驱动框架
translated_abstract: 尽管人类轨迹异常的研究对空间数据挖掘至关重要，但实证研究仍然受限于真值数据集的缺乏。尽管目前已有若干真实世界和模拟的人类轨迹数据集，但大多数仅包含正常移动模式，缺乏标注的异常。这一局限主要源于异常事件在现实世界中十分罕见且难以收集。此外，大规模移动数据的收集还受到严格的隐私法规和获取成本的阻碍。为了克服这些限制并建立一个带有标注真值的可解释人类轨迹异常数据集，我们引入了一个端到端的生成框架，旨在大规模合成具有上下文感知能力的轨迹异常。与现有模型不同，我们的框架对基线模拟轨迹施加真实世界的物理约束。我们采用大语言模型（LLM）智能体来……
tldr: 本文提出一种由大语言模型驱动的端到端生成框架，通过地图约束路由与传感器噪声模拟，大规模合成具有上下文感知能力且带有标注真值的人类轨迹异常数据，填补了轨迹异常研究中标注数据集缺失的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an LLM-driven end-to-end generative framework that synthesizes context-aware, ground-truth-annotated human trajectory anomalies at scale via map-constrained routing and sensor noise simulation, addressing the lack of labeled anomaly datasets in trajectory anomaly research.
